name: Finance
description: Commission engine and platform fee rules, the append-only seller ledger (sale, commission, fees, logistics, returns, penalties, claims, TCS/TDS, payouts), payout eligibility and holds, weekly payout batches through RazorpayX or manual bank transfers, GST tax invoices, credit notes and monthly fee invoices, the TCS (GSTR-8) report, COD remittance reconciliation, the reseller margin wallet, the supplier payments screens and the admin finance console.
